विदलामलक: विदलामलक This term occurs Kauṭ. 2, 15, 18 (text p. 74; transl. Kangle p. 142; transl. J. J. Meyer p. 141; transl. Sham. p. 101); (see App. 3: अम्ल). Sham. is of the opinion that it is a synonym of आमलक; J. J. Meyer (p. 141, footnote 7) is unsure about the meaning of the word; he seems to prefer to take the word as a compound and remarks that विदल (acc. to the dictionaries) designates BAUHINIA VARIEGATA, but acc. to Gaṇ. the pomegranate (दाडिम). In my opinion the word विदलामलक is a compound and the first member is विदल or विदला। विदल: (1) BAUHINIA VARIEGATA LINN. (MW; Vśs: = रक्तकाञ्चन); (2) B. PURPUREA LINN. (Vśs: = रक्तकाञ्चन); (3) the seeds of PUNICA GRANATUM LINN. (Vśs). विदला: (1) IPOMOEA TURPETHUM R. BR. (MW; Vśs); (2) = सातला (Vśs; variously identified, but acc. to Vśs. EUPHORBIA NERIFOLIA LINN.); (3) the bark of PUNICA GRANATUM LINN. (MW). The best solution is to read विदल and to take it in the sense of दाडिम (PUNICA GRANATUM LINN.) because the pomegranate is usually enumerated as one of the fruits called फलाम्ल। (Kangle also trans-lates: pomegranate).
